description: This script manages the status LEDs during different system states in an OpenWrt router environment. It identifies the appropriate LED device based on system conditions and sets its blinking or solid state accordingly.

methods.name: get_status_led
methods.description: Detects and sets the system status LED based on available LED devices.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the LED state based on the system's current initialization phase or status.
